summary: Author's own review against the critic checklist (no independent critic was run). Friendship (content/events/bonds/friends.grim): about four cards per peer, each finding out a fact or paying one off, and the close milestones of Lyra (it names Wildfire, which lyra_teaches_wildfire then teaches), Bram and Ilse as their own versions of soc_become_close. Rivalry (rivals.grim): eight cards each for Lyra and Bram, two each for a soured Corvin and Ilse; migration 0040 stops the generic truce pre-empting lyra_rival_respect and bram_turns, holds Bram's generic friendship until he has softened, keeps bram_turns from downgrading a close bond and leaves Tamsin's letters to her own cards. Plot safety: Ilse's and Kael's cards read only furs, frost-craft, cold hands and the North; nothing touches the cult, the door or the man in grey. Fixed during review: discovery cards were gated on `not knows(...)`, but surface facts are known from the first meeting and others unlock by friendship each month, so the gates would never pass (cards without repeat already play once); Lumenhold has four years, so the bullies are fourth-years; Lyra's second place was at the Trials before she came, so no trophy at Lumenhold; one option was over the ±1.5 budget.
